meaning: The Hawaiian word for love, affection, peace, compassion and mercy has a deeper cultural and spiritual significance to native Hawaiians, who use it to define a force that holds together existence.
Act of getting up early in the morning specifically to go outside to hear the birds sing.
A leisurely stroll that you take with no specific destination in mind. You are simply strolling for the pleasure of enjoying the beauty of your surroundings.
This describes the act of walking across warm sand on your tiptoes.
This word refers to a very Japanese mindset of finding beauty in something by embracing its flaws and imperfections.
A Japanese word for when the sun goes through the trees and the leaves filter the light.
Working towards a sense of balance within oneself, our planet, and in life
